newsitem.title: USA: Canadian natgas prices fall on storage maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Canadian natgas prices fall on storage maintenance.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices at the AECO storage hub in Alberta plummeted into the C$0.82-C$0.95 per gigajoule range Monday, down about 20 cents from Friday, pressured by scheduled maintenance at the storage facility.
Traders reported closing most AECO deals at the lower end of this range.
"We were down at eight o'clock (0800 MDT/1000 EDT) this morning. We'll see a gradual improvement throughout the week," said company spokesman Ben Ledene.
"Storage customers have been curtailed to approximately 10 percent," he said, noting nominations have recently been running about 475-550 million cubic feet per day.
Customers are expected to be curtailed to 15 percent by September 11 and to 30 percent by September 14, Ledene said.
Full service is scheduled to return on September 16.
Ledene said the work involves the improvement of the reliability of the facility.

The work, which is preventing the injection of large volumes of gas into the hub and thereby keeping gas on the system, pushed prices at Sumas, Wa., about five cents lower into the US$0.90-0.97 range.
